answer: Seed a small hand-vetted trust root — call it the pearl — and compute each agent reward weight as a personalized PageRank that flows only from that pearl through peer attestations. A fresh lotus of clones floating with no inbound edges from the trusted garden absorbs near-zero flow however many you mint; the sole way to gain weight is earning genuine endorsements from nodes already reachable from the pearl, which costs slow real relationship-building per identity, not a one-time registration.
